subject: Renewal QBR: demo timing and procurement prep
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena@atlashealth.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.com
Cc: procurements@atlashealth.com
Date: 2027-05-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal QBR: timeline pressure + demo request

Hi Mina —

Thanks again for the renewal QBR invite. We had a procurement sync this morning and there’s a hard internal deadline to get a demo and procurement packet over to finance by Friday, 5/21. Can we compress the QBR demo to a focused 45-minute walk-through that highlights the SLA, data residency, and cost controls?

Also attaching a short note from our procurement team to clarify timelines and initial questions. If you can propose two ~45min slots (PST) tomorrow or Friday morning that would be ideal — we’ll lock one and I’ll have our procurement lead copied to start the PO conversation.

Attachments: Atlas_PO_Inquiry.pdf

Thanks,
Elena Torres
Director, Vendor Sourcing
Atlas Health
From: mina_haddad@redwood.com
To: Elena Torres <elena@atlashealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-20T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR: timeline pressure + demo request

Elena —

Appreciate the heads up. We can absolutely compress to a 45-minute demo focused on the procurement asks you listed. Two slots that work on our side:

- Fri 5/21, 09:00–09:45 PT
- Fri 5/21, 11:30–12:15 PT (we can do a hard stop at 12:15)

I’ve looped in Marissa (Customer Success) and Rishi (Solutions Engineering) to own the agenda and technical SLAs. I’m attaching a trimmed QBR agenda (v3) that highlights the SLA/data residency/cost controls section so we can run to those items first.

If those times don’t work for procurement, tell me one preferred window and we’ll prioritize it. I can also prepare a one-page procurement packet (SOC2 link, IP/data flow summary, sample contract language) and drop it to your procurement alias before the meeting.

Attachments: QBR_Agenda_v3.pdf

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Account Executive — Renewals
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com | (415) 555-0122
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.com, Elena Torres <elena@atlashealth.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-20T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR: timeline pressure + demo request

Thanks Mina —

We can present a focused 45-minute run-through that is explicitly procurement-first. Proposed micro-agenda (45m):

1) 0–5m: quick intro & renewal milestones (Mina)
2) 5–25m: SLA, data residency, encryption & KMS options (Rishi)
3) 25–35m: cost controls, batching/quantization recommendations, estimated unit economics for Atlas Health (Marissa)
4) 35–40m: procurement checklist & timeline (Mina)
5) 40–45m: immediate next steps + PO/SOW handoff (All)

Priyom — can you own recording + drop the procurement one-pager to the procurement alias immediately after the call? If you can also prepare a bullet list of the minimal artifacts procurement usually asks for (SOC2, retention matrix, audit log sample) that will speed things up.

Elena — from our side either of Mina’s proposed slots works; if you prefer earlier coverage for finance, pick 09:00 PT and I’ll block the required resources.

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Torres <elena@atlashealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Cc: procurements@atlashealth.com
Date: 2027-05-21T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR: timeline pressure + demo request

Hi all —

We’ll take the 09:00–09:45 PT slot on Fri 5/21. Please confirm dial-in and share the procurement one-pager and SOC2 link beforehand so I can circulate to finance this morning. Our procurement lead (procurements@atlashealth.com) will begin the PO intake once we have the packet.

Also: we may need a short add-on 15-minute block after the demo to review contract redlines if possible — can someone from contracts be on standby? If not, we’ll capture notes and loop contracts into the ticket that day.

Thanks — looking forward to the fast run-through.

Elena
